lines.text: The LORD will come with fire and judge all flesh by fire and by His sword.
Those who purify themselves to enter the groves and follow one among swine eaters will perish together.
The LORD will gather all nations to see His glory and send survivors to Tarshish, Put, and Lud.
They will bring all your brothers on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels to Bethel, and some become priests.
Worshipers will go forth and see a river flowing from the mountain, and the rebels' worm will never die.

wrong_details.wrong: a river flowing from the mountain
wrong_details.true: the corpses of the men who rebelled
